newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Post renews airmail transport contracts.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Post renews airmail transport contracts.

text.p: Deutsche Post AG (DPAG) said it has renewed airmail transport contracts with Deutsche Lufthansa, Deutsche BA and Eurowings for a further two years
The three airlines won the first international tender to operate postal flights for the domestic German overnight mail delivery service, a statement said.
A DPAG spokesman told Reuters that the Germany-based carriers had retained their existing contracts in the face of bids from 25 domestic and foreign firms.
"We do not speak about the value of the contracts but of course it is clear that the overnight postal network is not cheap," he added.
Deutsche Post said that from October it will streamline its night mail network to 300 tonnes of letters and 41 routes instead of the present 430 tonnes on 45 routes.
Fewer flights were needed since a new network of 83 post centres would improve the capacity usage of both. aircraft and overland transport, it added.
The vast majority of routes will be flown by Lufthansa, with Deutsche BA operating the Cologne-Berlin and Cologne-Dresden services and Eurowings flying Cologne-Stuttgart and Cologne-Nuremberg.
